currentParagraphText: “I believe there is someone more qualified than I to speak on it,” the Sword Saint said as he reached out and touched the necklace. He infused some energy into it with the intent of waking up the soul slumbering within.

finalResult.nextParagraphText: His goal was to summon Iskar, who was effectively the steward of Sanguine’s Blood Legacy. He had been less active in recent years, and while he could still speak relatively frequently, manifesting himself outside of the Blood Legacy had become harder the more the Sword Saint grew in power.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: The vampire evaluated him for a few moments more before smiling. “You are an interesting mortal. My name is Katherine, the True Ancestor of the Nalkar Lineage and one of the leaders of the vampiric race. Now, please, do tell me everything you know about this artifact. I’ve not seen one like it for... I don’t even know how many eras.”
